input: Return only concise Bash test code. Previous rejected: relative temp dir + globalcd breaks paths, hardcodes minimalfixture instead actualmetadata, cp/mv notforce, set+e. Must follow this exact design: set -euo pipefail. checker="$PWD/scripts/check-beads-server-mode.sh"; fixture_dir=$(mktemp -d) (absolute); trap rm -rf quotedfixture EXIT. mkdir -p "$fixture_dir/valid/.beads" "$fixture_dir/negative/.beads". cp -f .beads/metadata.json "$fixture_dir/valid/.beads/metadata.json". Run (cd "$fixture_dir/valid" && bash "$checker") >"$fixture_dir/pass.out" 2>"$fixture_dir/pass.err". Require pass.out contents exactly "beads server-mode check passed" and pass.err empty. jq '. + {"dolt_server_port": 1}' .beads/metadata.json > "$fixture_dir/negative/.beads/metadata.json". if (cd "$fixture_dir/negative" && bash "$checker") >"$fixture_dir/fail.out" 2>"$fixture_dir/fail.err"; then echo unexpected success >&2;exit1;else status=$?;test "$status" -eq 1;fi. Require fail.out empty; fail.errcontents exactly "beads server-mode check failed: do not pin dolt_server_port in metadata; bd manages .beads/dolt-server.port". Print2regressioncasespassed. Neverglobalcd, neverdeleteactivefiles, no servercommands. Only final fullcode.
